note: The told scope below is what a QA engineer is handed: the ticket and the PR's testing notes, restated in our own words (summarised, not quoted). Nothing else from the conversation around the ticket is used.
told: Ticket #558: Backend accepts pet birth dates in the future.
Steps: send POST /owners/{ownerId}/pets or PUT /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId} with birthDate 2030-01-01. Expected 400 Bad Request; today it is saved, through the API and through the UI pet form.
Also: processUpdateForm had no @Valid, so @Size on name was not enforced on update.
PR #559 testing: unit tests for POST and PUT return 400 for a future birth date.
Known gap: the frontend shows no validation error when the save fails, tracked in #557.
